            <milestone unit="section" n="223.212.211.212 ha cang thal ba"/>
            gnyis pa ni kha dog 'dzin pas reg pa la zhen pa 'dren pa tsam gyis tshad mar 'gyur na bzhin 'dzum pa 'dzin pa yang sems dga' ba la tshad mar 'gyur te de la zhen pa 'dren par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro || 
         de la <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4206">rtag</rs> na re</note><note type="editorial">Reading rtag or stag</note> gal te bzhin 'dzum pa 'di nyid sems dga' ba yin zhes snang yul du zhen pa 'dren pa med do zhe na |
         kha dog 'dzin pa yang reg pa la snang yul du zhen <lb n="21a7"/> pa 'dren <choice><reg>pa</reg><orig>pa{°}</orig></choice> med pas tshad ma ma yin par 'gyur ro ||</seg></TEI>
